title: Novera workflow profile
description: Versioned, machine-readable authorization profile for a NovaDeed workflow. A profile defines who may propose a transition, which confirmations are required, and which policies or evidence categories gate the transition. Profiles are configuration records, not legal rules or regulatory determinations.

workflowProfileId.description: Stable namespaced identifier for this workflow profile family.

profileVersion.description: Semantic version of this exact profile definition.

workflowType.description: Workflow type to which this profile applies.

transitionRules.description: Machine-readable authorization rules for transitions governed by this profile.

state.description: Workflow state used by a profile rule.

role.description: Workflow role permitted or required by an authorization rule.

proposerRule.description: Actors allowed to propose a transition.

actorTypes.description: Actor types that may propose the transition.

roles.description: Permitted workflow roles when the proposer has a role. Empty or absent means the profile does not further restrict role for an allowed actor type.

requiredActor.description: One actor class and role whose confirmation is required.

role.description: Required confirmer role, when role-based authorization applies.

count.description: Minimum number of distinct confirmations satisfying this requirement.

confirmationRule.description: Confirmation threshold and separation-of-duties requirements for one transition.

minCount.description: Minimum total number of distinct confirmation events required.

disallowProposerConfirmation.description: When true, the actor that proposed the transition cannot satisfy a confirmation requirement.

transitionRule.description: Authorization and gating rule for one workflow-state transition.

from.description: Source state, or null for creation.

confirmation.description: Confirmations required before the transition can be applied.

requiredPolicyIds.description: Policies that MUST have a current permitting result before this transition may be applied.

requiredEvidenceTypes.description: Evidence categories the workflow profile requires for this transition. v0.1 records this requirement but does not yet resolve every referenced evidence record in the validator.
